primary.title: Experiments in Plant Hybridization
primary.author: Gregor Mendel
primary.rationale: Mendel's seminal paper, which laid the foundation for the science of genetics. It is widely available in English translation.

secondary.title: Gregor Mendel: A Life
secondary.author: Vitezslav Orel
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive biography of Mendel by a leading Mendel scholar, drawing on extensive archival research.

secondary.title: The Monk and the Philosopher: The Search for Meaning
secondary.author: Jean-Pierre Changeux and Paul Ricoeur
secondary.rationale: While not solely about Mendel, this book discusses his work in the context of broader scientific and philosophical inquiry into genetics and heredity.

secondary.title: Mendel's Principles of Heredity
secondary.author: William Bateson
secondary.rationale: Although published before 1976, Bateson's work was crucial in reintroducing Mendel's findings to the scientific community and is considered a foundational secondary source.

suggestions.notes: Gregor Mendel's primary written output is his groundbreaking paper on plant hybridization. Secondary sources are abundant, with many biographies and analyses of his work available.
